title: Agent A: A puzzle in disguise
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#943, 2026-11-03), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.24, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, D3DMetal, rated 2 of 5 after 1 minutes: the title screen says Authentication failed. The log has D3DMetal's 'Unsupported: IDXGIResource::GetSharedHandle', then crash dumps and the Epic overlay's crash reporter starting, the Epic copy. Not verified by the maintainer. udance4ever again in a comment on highball-db#943 (2026-11-03): the same Authentication failed with DXMT. The game has an Epic Mac version, which the reporter will try once Highball can install Epic Mac versions (highball#361). udance4ever again on highball-db#943 (2026-11-12): the Epic Mac version, installed through Highball 0.10.27, works. It opens a web page to sign in to Epic at launch, and a DualSense works, though it's a point and click game played with the mouse.
notes: The Windows version doesn't get past the title screen in one report on an M1, with D3DMetal or DXMT, the Epic copy: the game says Authentication failed. The Epic purchase includes a Mac version, which works for the same player through Highball 0.10.27 (highball-db#943). A Unity game, Direct3D 11.

knownIssues.symptom: 'Authentication failed' on the title screen (Epic copy, M1, D3DMetal and DXMT, Wine 10 r29)
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed. The log shows D3DMetal answering 'Unsupported: IDXGIResource::GetSharedHandle', then crash dumps and the Epic overlay's crash reporter starting. Whether that is what fails the sign-in is not known
knownIssues.fix: play the Epic Mac version, which Highball installs since 0.10.27 (highball-db#943, credit udance4ever)
